title: Grateful Dead Live at The Silver Dollar Fair on 1968-11-01
lineage: DAT (Panasonic SV-3800) > Avid MBox Pro > Pro Tools 12 > WAV (16-bit/44.1k)  Additional Mastering: WAV > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC
source: SBD > (8-track) Master Reel (10in 15ips) > DAT (Panasonic SV-3700) > DAT (Panasonic SV-3700)

ai_review.summary: A stellar multi‑track capture of a high‑energy Cryptical Envelopment > The Other One, though occasional tape glitches mar portions of the recording.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the fire and inspired coda in the Cryptical Envelopment > The Other One sequence, noting the multi‑track source delivers exceptional clarity and energy when Garcia returns. However, the recording suffers from noticeable signal dropouts during the Alligator jam into Caution, leaving the tape quality uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance is rated very high while recording quality is split between excellent multi‑track sections and problematic dropouts, yielding a solid overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multi‑track source provides clear, listenable sound on most of the show; however, parts (notably Alligator jam into Caution) exhibit poor signal and possible dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong momentum built around the Cryptical/Other One segment with high energy, though tape glitches interrupt continuity in later jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as playfully snarling, piercing and bringing real energy when he returns to the mix.
